tests.name: the replication role machvon_sync (ST-KERNEL-045) AC-ST-KERNEL-045-3 UAT-AC500: has REPLICATION, is neither a superuser nor able to bypass row-level security, and inherits nothing from another role
the replication role machvon_sync (ST-KERNEL-045) AC-ST-KERNEL-045-3 UAT-AC500: has SELECT on every table of the publication powersync and on no other table
the replication role machvon_sync (ST-KERNEL-045) AC-ST-KERNEL-045-3 UAT-AC500: holds no other privilege on any table, column, sequence, the schema or the database

the replication role machvon_sync (ST-KERNEL-045) AC-ST-KERNEL-045-3 UAT-AC500: publishes the tables of the sync contract and the scope table of the bucket parameters, and none of the tables that must not reach a phone

the replication role machvon_sync (ST-KERNEL-045) AC-ST-KERNEL-045-3 UAT-AC500: running the script again leaves the same privileges, and takes back a privilege that crept onto a table outside the publication
